what_happened.line: The Board of Health granted the variances for 81 Maple Parkway, including a reduced wetlands setback, by a 4-0 roll-call vote.
The Board of Health granted a septic variance and local upgrade approval for 93 White Street, reducing the groundwater offset, by a 4-0 roll-call vote.
The agent briefed the board on new governor's COVID orders and a rise in local cases, then agreed to give weekly case numbers alongside totals.
Members asked about precautions at the next day's town meeting, and the October 19 minutes were approved after a note-taking arrangement was made.

why_it_matters: The variances let two properties proceed with septic systems that depart from standard Title 5 setbacks and groundwater separation, which bears on nearby wetlands and groundwater.
Weekly case counts from the agent would give residents a clearer view of local COVID trends than cumulative totals alone.
watch_next: The engineer's correction to the typo in the 93 White Street request, and the agent's case-tracking spreadsheet and weekly case numbers for the board.
